records.title: Structured Alpha funds: AGI U.S. pleaded guilty to securities fraud
records.summary: The DOJ said AGI U.S. concealed fund downside risks, misrepresented hedging and altered investor materials. It pleaded guilty to one count of securities fraud and was sentenced in 2023.
details: The funds held more than USD 11 billion in assets at their peak.
The sentence included more than USD 2.33 billion in fines, USD 3.23 billion in restitution and more than USD 463 million in forfeiture.
The DOJ separately reported civil settlements of more than USD 5 billion. These figures are kept separate and are not added together here.

records.title: SEC obtained final judgments against three former portfolio managers
records.entity: Gregoire Tournant, Trevor Taylor and Stephen Bond-Nelson
records.summary: The SEC reported final civil judgments and industry bars connected to the Structured Alpha scheme. Tournant had separately pleaded guilty to investment-adviser fraud.
details: The SEC says investors placed about USD 11 billion into Structured Alpha and that investor materials were manipulated to conceal risk.
The judgments followed parallel criminal proceedings. The SEC release reports forfeiture amounts for each manager.

records.title: Allianz Australia and AWP convicted over travel-insurance statements
records.entity: Allianz Australia Insurance Limited and AWP Australia Pty Ltd
records.summary: The NSW Supreme Court convicted the companies after misleading online information overstated the travel-insurance benefits available without adequately presenting sub-limits, terms and exclusions.
details: The court imposed criminal fines of AUD 13.5 million on Allianz Australia and AUD 3.3 million on AWP Australia.
ASIC said the conduct exposed thousands of customers to a risk of misunderstanding their cover.

records.date_label: Inspection began 12 November 2018 · fine imposed 25 March 2022 · court confirmed 7 February 2025
records.title: CSSF fine for AML/CFT control failures upheld by the Luxembourg Administrative Court
records.entity: Allianz Global Investors GmbH, Zweigniederlassung Luxembourg
records.summary: The CSSF imposed a EUR 283,000 administrative fine after finding persistent deficiencies in the branch's anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorist-financing framework. The Administrative Court confirmed all aspects of the sanction in 2025.
details: The CSSF cited an incomplete activity-wide risk analysis, gaps in investor due diligence and ongoing monitoring, missing management approval for intermediary files, incomplete screening evidence, and an insufficient internal audit cycle.

records.title: Reported gaps in Zurich life-insurance applications
records.entity: Allianz Suisse Zurich general agency and an external broker
records.summary: Inside Paradeplatz reported that about 1,000 of roughly 2,500 applications from one broker were incomplete and that agency staff filled missing fields. The article said Allianz Suisse opened an internal compliance review and had ended the broker relationship.
details: The report attributes the application counts and the account of a whistleblower alert to its sources. They have not been independently verified here.
A follow-up raised questions about what senior managers knew. Those claims remain unverified in the sources reviewed.

records.title: Allianz24 applicant rejected after an apparently incorrect credit check
records.summary: SRF reported that an applicant was refused motor insurance after a creditworthiness check appeared to associate her with debts belonging to people with the same name. An Allianz spokesperson told SRF there were no objective grounds for the decision and apologised for an error.
details: Allianz denied operating a blacklist based on nationality or name.
The source reports that Allianz maintained a list of former customers with negative experiences.

records.title: Federal Supreme Court set aside Allianz Suisse's denial of accident benefits in one case
records.entity: Allianz Suisse Versicherungs-Gesellschaft AG · cases 8C_485/2023 and 8C_510/2023
records.summary: The Federal Supreme Court held that Allianz Suisse owed accident-insurance benefits for a 2020 injury and set aside the prior cantonal judgment and Allianz's contrary decision.
details: The judgment concerned the insurance status of a part-time employee who also worked as a self-employed farmer.
The Court allowed the claim and ordered the cantonal proceedings' costs and compensation to be reassessed.

records.date_label: Current Allianz Suisse disclosure, accessed 8 November 2026
records.title: Allianz Suisse's HIS disclosure describes challenge and deletion rights
records.entity: Allianz Suisse and the Swiss Hinweis- und Informationssystem (HIS)
records.summary: Allianz says an HIS entry alone cannot justify refusing a claim. Its disclosure lists the grounds for an entry, individual access and correction routes, and automatic deletion seven years after the loss date.
details: The company says entries can be challenged if the legal grounds are absent or the data are incorrect.
The policy also describes data shared with the HIS operator and the system's role in claim review.

records.title: Federal Supreme Court upheld Allianz Suisse's withdrawal of previously awarded accident benefits
records.summary: After Allianz had taken over the case from SUVA and paid benefits retroactively, it later withdrew the award after receiving documents from the at-fault driver's liability insurer. The Federal Supreme Court allowed Allianz's appeal and confirmed its denial.
details: The claimant had earlier received an invalidity pension and other benefits under decisions issued by SUVA and then Allianz.
The Court's 2016 judgment reversed the cantonal judgment that had ordered Allianz to continue payments.

records.date_label: Allianz Group 2025 Annual Report · Allianz Suisse 2025 report
records.title: 2025 reports describe compliance tracking and report no anti-corruption convictions
records.summary: Allianz Group's 2025 Annual Report describes its Supervisory Proceedings Database, which includes criminal proceedings against Allianz personnel related to work and proceedings against group subsidiaries. Its anti-corruption and anti-bribery table shows dashes for convictions and fines in 2024 and 2025.
details: Allianz Suisse's 2025 financial-condition report identifies the Swiss entities and describes corporate governance and risk controls.

research_steps.coverage: ASIC’s official release on Allianz Australia Insurance Limited and AWP Australia Pty Ltd.
research_steps.result: The dossier records the February 2025 convictions and company-specific fines reported by ASIC.
research_steps.next_action: Check for additional named ASIC proceedings involving the relevant Allianz entities.

research_steps.name: CSSF Luxembourg AML sanction
research_steps.coverage: CSSF’s sanction record for Allianz Global Investors GmbH, Zweigniederlassung Luxembourg, including the 2025 appeal outcome.
research_steps.result: The dossier records the EUR 283,000 sanction and the Administrative Court confirmation. This is a Luxembourg asset-management branch matter.
research_steps.next_action: Check CSSF records for other named Allianz entities or proceedings before treating this as the full Luxembourg search.

research_steps.name: Historical Swiss front-running report, 2000–2001
research_steps.coverage: The supplied plan cites a Swissinfo report about a former Allianz employee and Zurich court convictions.
research_steps.result: The prior collector candidate resolved to unrelated content, so this item is not included as a dossier finding pending a correct source and outcome check.
research_steps.next_action: Locate the correct Swissinfo report and corroborate the court outcome, the employee’s stated affiliation, and the report that Allianz was the victim.

research_steps.name: Zurich life-insurance application reporting and outcome
research_steps.status: Reporting collected; public outcome search open
research_steps.coverage: Inside Paradeplatz reports from December 2022 and January 2023 about incomplete applications, the reported internal review, and follow-up claims.
research_steps.result: The current dossier identifies the application counts and management-knowledge claims as reporting, not independently verified facts. No public final outcome of Allianz Suisse’s internal review is recorded.
research_steps.next_action: Check official company, regulator and court records for a published outcome or later documented proceeding.

research_steps.name: FINMA enforcement records
research_steps.status: Database pages collected; case-level audit in progress
research_steps.coverage: FINMA enforcement reporting and its anonymised insurance-law court-decision database.
research_steps.result: The current sources explain the databases. No unidentified anonymised record has been attributed to Allianz Suisse.
research_steps.next_action: Compare case facts and dates against candidate decisions; do not attribute an anonymised record without a reliable match.

research_steps.name: SEC EDGAR search
research_steps.status: Structured Alpha records reviewed; broader search open
research_steps.coverage: SEC final judgments in Structured Alpha and the EDGAR full-text search entry point.
research_steps.result: Specific Structured Alpha records are in the dossier. The broad EDGAR name search has not been completed.
research_steps.next_action: Select entity- and matter-specific filings before adding any further records.

research_steps.name: DOJ corporate proceedings
research_steps.status: Structured Alpha reviewed; broader search open
research_steps.coverage: DOJ charging and sentencing records for AGI U.S. in Structured Alpha.
research_steps.result: The current dossier contains the guilty plea and sentencing material for this case; it does not establish that all DOJ proceedings involving Allianz entities have been searched.
research_steps.next_action: Check for other named Allianz-entity prosecutions and add only record-specific primary sources.

research_steps.name: Allianz directors’ dealings and executive disclosures
research_steps.coverage: Official dealings notices, shareholding disclosures, transaction dates, executive departures and prior positions requested in the plan.
research_steps.result: No transaction-level or person-level result is currently included in the dossier.
research_steps.next_action: Extract named official disclosures and verify each person, transaction, date and role. Do not treat transaction timing alone as evidence of misconduct.

research_steps.name: Violation Tracker Global
research_steps.coverage: The plan names the database as an aggregator for identifying possible penalties and proceedings.
research_steps.result: No Violation Tracker lead has been added to the dossier.
research_steps.next_action: Use any entry only as a lead, then verify the underlying penalty or case in the regulator or court record.

research_steps.name: Swiss Federal Supreme Court and claims-handling records
research_steps.coverage: Official Federal Supreme Court decisions involving Allianz Suisse and FINMA’s anonymised insurance-law database.
research_steps.result: The dossier includes 8C_193/2016 and 8C_485/2023 with 8C_510/2023. These are individual accident-insurance decisions with different outcomes.
research_steps.next_action: Expand across civil, insurance and criminal decisions for 2010–2026 and log each relevant outcome with the exact entity and case number.

research_steps.name: Allianz 2025 Annual Report and Allianz Suisse SFCR
research_steps.status: Official reports fetched; selected disclosures reviewed
research_steps.coverage: Allianz Group Annual Report 2025 and Allianz Suisse Report on the Financial Condition 2025.
research_steps.result: The dossier records the Group report’s supervisory-proceedings database description and anti-corruption table, plus the Swiss report’s entity, governance and risk disclosures.
research_steps.next_action: Use report disclosures as company statements and cross-check any named matter against primary case records.

research_steps.name: Swiss credit screening, personal data and HIS
research_steps.status: One reported incident and current policy reviewed; case search open
research_steps.coverage: SRF’s 2014 Allianz24 report and Allianz Suisse’s current HIS disclosure.
research_steps.result: SRF reported one apparent credit-check error and Allianz’s apology. Allianz’s current policy describes HIS entry grounds, access and correction routes, and deletion timing; the policy is not evidence of how a disputed individual entry was handled.
research_steps.next_action: Search for specific court, regulator or documented customer records about claims handling, inaccurate allegations of fraud and personal-data processing.
